# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ User profile rendering module. This module provides a single function `generate_user_profile` that safely renders user supplied data into an HTML snippet for web display. All user-supplied strings are escaped to prevent XSS attacks. """ import html # Template for the user profile. The placeholders are named # `username`, `biography` and `status`. This can be replaced with a # more complex template engine if needed. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{username}

{biography}

Status: {status}
""" def generate_user_profile(username: str, biography: str, status: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A user‑written biography that may contain multiple sentences. status : str The user's current status message. Returns ------- str An HTML snippet with the sanitized user profile information. Raises ------ ValueError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username, biography, status)): raise ValueError("All arguments must be strings") # Escape user-provided content to avoid XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_biography = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(status, quote=True) # Render the template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, biography=safe_biography, status=safe_status )
